verdict.rationale: Bento's homepage claims revenue attribution to emails and flows: "Tie sales and recurring revenue back to the email or flow that came before." Supporting docs describe `$purchase` events carrying an amount and deduplication so revenue is not double-counted. The attribution capability itself appears only as a one-line marketing claim, with no detailed docs on how it works or what it reports. Missing for 10: documentation of the attribution model and reporting, attribution of signups (not just revenue), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks

citations.quote: Tie sales and recurring revenue back to the email or flow that came before.
It lets Bento count revenue correctly without double-counting the same order if a thank you page reloads or your app retries the event.
`$purchase` with details like amount and product
